title: Mixtures and Solutions
seo_title: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology: Mixtures and Solutions Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology: Solids, liquids and gases; mixtures; solutions; dissolving
standard_text: Solids, liquids and gases are made of particles. A mixture contains two or more substances that are not chemically joined. In a solution, a solute dissolves in a solvent. Dissolving is faster with stirring, heating and smaller particles. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 6, Matter and Materials: Solids, liquids and gases; mixtures; solutions; dissolving)
meta_desc: Free Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): particles in solids, liquids and gases, mixtures, solutions, solutes and solvents, and how fast things dissolve. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: In a solution the solute dissolves in the solvent.
key_sub: Stirring, heating and small pieces dissolve faster.
body_html:
How to think about it

A mixture contains two or more substances mixed together but not joined, such as sand and water or salt and water. Some mixtures can be separated by hand-sorting, sieving, filtering or evaporating.

A solution is a special mixture where the solute (sugar) dissolves in the solvent (water) and cannot be seen. Sugar dissolves faster when the water is hot, when it is stirred and when the sugar grains are small. A saturated solution cannot dissolve any more solute.

Example

In sugar water, which is the solute?

What dissolves?

Answer: sugar

Example

How can you get salt back from salt water?

Let the water go.

Answer: evaporate the water

Common mistakes

  • Thinking dissolved sugar has disappeared.
  • Mixing up solute and solvent.
  • Thinking sand dissolves in water.

faq.q: Why does sugar dissolve faster in hot tea?
faq.a: The particles move faster and mix more quickly.

items.q: Which state of matter does the model show?

items.q: Snow disappears on a sunny winter day without melting. What happened?
c: It sublimated, turning straight into water vapour.
items.e: Sublimation skips the liquid state.

items.q: Which is the best way to separate steel pins and sawdust?
items.e: Use using a magnet because steel is magnetic.

items.q: In separating mixtures, what is an evaporating dish?
c: a shallow dish heated so water evaporates
the solid left in the filter paper
the liquid that passes through the filter
has tiny holes that let liquid through but trap insoluble bits
items.e: An evaporating dish: a shallow dish heated so water evaporates.

items.q: What can evaporating separate?
c: an insoluble solid from a liquid
a dissolved solid from a liquid
a magnetic metal from other materials
items.e: Each method uses a different property.

items.q: Which is the best way to separate muddy water?
items.e: Use filtering because mud is made of insoluble bits.

items.q: Which method separates a magnetic metal from other materials?

items.q: Which is the best way to separate sand and water?
